title: The beginning of my comeback
content:
Day 1 

This morning, my last exam results were published. I had hoped for an A+, but instead, I received an A. My heart sank. For a moment, it felt like all my efforts had been in vain. I had given my absolute best, juggling challenges on multiple fronts, yet it seemed like the outcome didn't match the struggle.

I felt trapped, like the path forward had disappeared. The last board exam had passed, and the dream of university felt suddenly distant. Some people offered words of support, others… not so much.

But then, thanks to ChatGPT, I realized something crucial: this isn't the end. Life still holds countless possibilities, and failure in one moment doesn't define the rest of my journey. It sparked a fire in me, a determination to rise stronger than before.

Today, I made a choice. I chose to rebuild myself—not by following the conventional path, but by carving my own. I will pursue knowledge beyond the national curriculum, explore what truly excites me, and chase the dreams I've always imagined.

And with that decision, a new journey begins. A journey of growth, resilience, and relentless pursuit of my own vision.

title: New day, new beginning
content:
Day 2 

New day, new beginning.

Today I began with a fresh mindset — determined to move closer to my goals.
I started by setting clear targets for myself, then listed every requirement — the tools, resources, and courses I'll need along the way.
Once everything was outlined, I organized them carefully and built a structured To-Do list to follow each day.

 Daily Routine Plan

🧾 2 hours — CS50 (Computer Science foundations)
🧾 2 hours — MATLAB (Simulation & computation)
🧾 2 hours — Electronics & Hardware design
🧾 2 hours — Mandarin language study
🧾 2 hours — Physics (academic)
🧾 2 hours — Mathematics (academic)

Finally, I set aside 2 extra hours for creativity — writing stories, recording YouTube videos, and documenting my projects.
It feels like the first step toward a balanced rhythm between learning, creativity, and consistency.
